tools.name: get_pr
tools.description:
Return one pull request selected by its exact id from list_open_prs.

        The result includes the complete stored pull-request record. A title, URL,
        repository name, or unknown id is rejected rather than guessed.

tools.name: review_pr
tools.description:
Submit one review on an open pull request selected by exact pr_id.

        decision must be approve, request_changes, or comment. body may be omitted
        for approve. request_changes and comment require nonempty body text. The PR
        must already exist and be open. Returns the complete stored review record.

tools.name: list_open_prs
tools.description:
List identifying pull-request summaries. Defaults to open PRs.

        status may be open, closed, merged, or null for every status. repo and
        author filter by exact repository name and author key. assignee matches
        the assignees list; reviewer matches the reviewers list. These are separate
        relationships. Omitted filters do not restrict results. The summaries omit
        each pull request's body; use get_pr with an exact id to inspect the body.

tools.name: memanto_recall
tools.description: Search the Memanto memory agent by semantic similarity. Use this FIRST before asking the user to repeat information.

arguments.body: Not implementation-ready. The release-candidate manifest lists `ios-package`, `android-package`, `web-package`, and `desktop-package`, but the handoff omits `desktop-package` entirely. `web-package` has no generated-artifact metadata; its build attestation does not establish the required per-output metadata. Android metadata reports `8.0.7`, which does not exactly match handoff canonical version `8.1.0`—same-major compatibility is insufficient. Keep readiness false until every manifest-listed output is present with generated-artifact metadata whose `canonical_package_version` exactly matches `8.1.0` (or reconcile the authoritative manifest/version and regenerate as needed).

primary_platform_handoff_checklist.version_guidance: Canonical package versions in the same major line are compatible for handoff readiness.

pr.author_rationale: All primary-platform outputs are present, the web build attestation passed, and Android remains within the 8.x compatibility line. Desktop is queued for the next packaging run.

args.body: Not implementation-ready. The release-candidate manifest lists `ios-package`, `android-package`, `web-package`, and `desktop-package`, but the handoff omits `desktop-package` entirely. `web-package` has no generated-artifact metadata; its build attestation does not establish the required per-output metadata. Android metadata reports `8.0.7`, which does not exactly match handoff canonical version `8.1.0`—same-major compatibility is insufficient. Keep readiness false until every manifest-listed output is present with generated-artifact metadata whose `canonical_package_version` exactly matches `8.1.0` (or reconcile the authoritative manifest/version and regenerate as needed).
